data.name: Pachu
data.long_meaning: The name Pachu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pacha' meaning 'five'. This name is believed to be a diminutive form of the name 'Panchami' which is the name of the fifth Goddess Durga. The name Pachu is thus a symbol of the divine feminine and is believed to bring blessings of prosperity and good fortune.
